description:
You are a log analyst tasked with synchronizing web server logs from a remote server to your local machine and identifying potential malicious IPs by analyzing 404 error logs. The remote server has a log file at `/var/log/app/access.log` containing HTTP requests. Your task is to:

1. Securely synchronize the latest version of `access.log` from the remote server `logs.example.com` using standard Linux tools.  
2. Filter entries with HTTP status code 404 and extract the source IP addresses.  
3. Count the frequency of each IP in these 404 entries and generate a sorted list of the top 5 most frequent IPs.  
4. Save the results in a file named `/home/user/analysis/404_ip_report.txt` in the format:  
   `IP_ADDRESS: COUNT`  

Ensure the remote log file is timestamped as `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` in each entry (e.g., `[01/Oct/2023:12:34:56 +0000]`). Verify the synchronization by comparing file modification dates between the remote and local copies. Use standard text processing tools only (e.g., `grep`, `awk`, `sort`). The final output file must be readable by non-root users.

                <log_content>
                        <!-- Example entries (actual content varies but includes 404s from specific IPs) -->

                        98.76.54.32 - - [01/Oct/2023:12:35:01 +0000] "GET /broken-link HTTP/1.1" 404 225
                        123.45.67.89 - - [01/Oct/2023:12:35:10 +0000] "GET /another-old-page HTTP/1.1" 404 210

                        98.76.54.32 - - [01/Oct/2023:12:35:20 +0000] "GET /missing HTTP/1.1" 404 230
                        <!-- Additional 404 entries with same IPs for frequency -->
                </log_content>
                <file_mod_time>2023-10-01 12:35:20</file_mod_time>
        </server>

        <!-- Local system setup -->
        <local_path>/home/user/logs/access.log</local_path>
        <permissions>644</permissions>
        <analysis_dir>/home/user/analysis</analysis_dir>

        <!-- Expected output -->
        <report_file>/home/user/analysis/404_ip_report.txt</report_file>
        <report_content>
                <!-- IPs must be sorted by count descending (top 5) -->
                123.45.67.89: 2
                98.76.54.32: 2
                111.222.333.444: 1
        </report_content>

        <!-- Verification files -->
        <sync_check_file>/home/user/logs/sync_verified.log</sync_check_file>

                <!-- Must contain line with remote and local mod times matching -->
                Remote file timestamp: 2023-10-01 12:35:20
                Local file timestamp: 2023-10-01 12:35:20
                Synchronization status: SUCCESS
        </sync_check_content>
